question: What comprehensive nature is attributed to the great pedestal?
premises: The great pedestal is the subject.
It is described as having an all-encompassing nature.
This description is stated as authoritative.
inference: The great pedestal is declared to be all-natured.
uncertainties: The scope of sarvātmakam is doctrinally broad and not fully specified here.
plain_english: O best of the twice-born, the great pedestal is thus declared to be all-natured.
